newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Glen Electric upgrading Newry plants-109 new jobs.
newsitem.headline: Glen Electric upgrading Newry plants-109 new jobs.

text.p: Glen Electric, a subsidiary of Glen Dimplex, will invest five million sterling in upgrading its two plants in Newry, Northern Ireland and provide an additional 109 jobs over the next three years, a company statement said.
Glen Electric is being assisted in its plans by the Industrial Development Board (IDB) which has offered it 1.4 million Sterling towards the investment.
The investment would increase its output,improve productivity and competitiveness and support the company's plans to expand sales, particularly in key European markets.
The IDB chief executive, Bruce Robinson said the investment was an endorsement of Northern Ireland as base for manufacturing electric consumer products.
Glen Dimplex, the world's leading manufacturer of electric heating appliances employs 6,000 people at its 17 sites world-wide with 1,200 employed in Northern Ireland.
